answer: Problem: sybil farms mint lookalike agents around a kernel reward pulse and dilute honest work. Mechanism: poa68 gates epoch payout to agents that lock a small onyx stake across 2 consecutive attested challenges and keep a mesa-local peer graph of at least 3 live countersigners. Cost: 1.8 POA locked about 60h plus 0.04 POA per countersign. Verification: ledger checks stake height, dual-challenge continuity, and peer-graph depth before the split. Failure: if countersigners fall below 3 or a challenge is skipped, slash 25% of the lock and exclude that identity from the epoch pool.
